275350941.description:
Arrowhead Lot
Mixed Stone Projectile Points
16 Items, Various Materials
This collection of sixteen projectile points features a diverse range of lithic materials and knapping styles. The lot includes various point shapes including corner-notched, side-notched, and stemmed bases, reflecting common regional designs. These pieces serve as excellent examples of stone tool craftsmanship across different mineral types such as obsidian, chert, and jasper. No brand name or maker's mark is readable on any of the items.
ITEMS INCLUDED:
1.
Black Obsidian Point
- Glassy volcanic stone, approximately 2.5 inches
2.

- Dark red stone with fine flaking
3.

- Speckled grey material, stemmed base
4.

- Light tan stone, corner-notched
5.
Brown Flint Point
- Deep brown stone, side-notched
6.
Mottled Grey/Brown Point
- Largest piece in lot, approximately 3.75 inches, stemmed base
7.
Light Grey Stone Point
- Triangular shape, small size
8.
Red Ochre Point
- Large, elongated reddish stone point
9.
Dark Grey Stone Point
- Side-notched with tapered tip
10.

- Small, sturdy point with corner notches
11.
Speckled Tan Point
- Textured stone with tapered base
12.
Dark Brown Point
- Mottled flint-like material
13.
Grey/Tan Point
- Leaf-shaped design
14.

- Compact point, roughly knapped
15.

- Standard chert construction
16.
Light Tan Point
- Smooth surface, triangular base
Condition:
Good vintage condition. All items show authentic weathering and percussion flaking marks. Most pieces show adhesive residue or tape remnants on the reverse side from previous display mounting. Several points exhibit minor edge chips consistent with age. All pieces appear structurally sound.
